title: PPSSPP 1.18.1: official stable release
summary: PPSSPP published 1.18.1 on November 4, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation Portable emulator project.
searchKeywords: PlayStation Portable emulator release update changelog

blocks.text: The PPSSPP project published version 1.18.1 on November 4, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official release description states: PPSSPP is a cross-platform PSP emulator. Visit PPSSPP official website for a full changelog as well as the downloads section for other platforms.
